key_takeaways: Version control solves file chaos, enables safe experimentation, provides disaster recovery
Git's distributed architecture eliminates single point of failure
Branching in Git is instant and encouraged (vs slow and avoided in CVS)
GitHub ecosystem extends Git with collaboration, CI/CD, and portfolio features
Git is foundational infrastructure for CatchBook development
